visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a car in early morning dimness, a woman with blonde-streaked bangs wears a light green baseball cap, glasses, and a grey ribbed zip-up top. She looks into the camera, speaking with animated facial expressions. In the shadowed back seat, another young woman with dark hair holds up a portion of a bright red banner featuring a cartoon cake and yellow Chinese characters. (2) The scene moves to a brightly lit airport terminal with high ceilings and white tiled flooring. The woman in the cap walks briskly while filming herself. Her friend follows closely, holding a white rectangular cake box with a yellow circular sticker. They pass airport signage and glass partitions. (3) A shot from a distance shows a woman with her hair in a high ponytail, wearing a black coat and a white face mask, pushing a luggage cart loaded with several suitcases and bags. She walks toward the camera through a mostly empty arrivals area. (4) The woman in the cap and several friends suddenly unfurl a massive red banner with yellow text that reads 'Taiwan's most beautiful photographer Lin Jieyu, Welcome Home'. The birthday girl in the black coat stops, looking shocked and placing her hand over her masked face. (5) The group gathers around the birthday girl at a counter with a 'No pick up' yellow sign. The woman in the cap presents a small, colorful hand-drawn card. The video ends with a group of seven people gathered behind the banner, smiling and gesturing for a commemorative photo.
